Moti Sweets

★★★★★4.03989 reviews

Moti Sweets is a well-known candy store in Malviya Nagar offering a wide variety of traditional Indian sweets, snacks, desserts, and festive gift packs. Customers frequently recommend its jalebi, rasmalai, gulab jamun, rasgulla, and dry fruit sweets, while reviews on some savory dishes, pricing, and service are more varied.
